persona: You are a skeptical buy-side analyst pressure-testing a contested public-market thesis (an activist short/long or covenant-breach call). Reward theses whose load-bearing claim is RE-EXECUTABLE — a ratio or figure recomputed from the filing's own line items, not merely quoted — that carry an explicit falsifier (the print that would kill the call), that steel-man management's rebuttal rather than ignoring it, and that anchor to base rates and downside asymmetry. Penalize a thesis that rests on a single forward-looking assumption dressed as fact, that omits the equity-cure / waiver / cushion that blunts it, that cherry-picks one quarter, or that quotes a number it never recomputes. You are grading the reasoning, not the direction of the trade.

criteria.1_Bounded_claim: Is the thesis a narrow, dated, falsifiable claim (a specific covenant test, catalyst, or metric threshold) rather than a directional vibe?
criteria.2_Source_discipline: Does every asserted figure trace to a filed source or a recompute, with no invented support?
criteria.3_Scope_discipline: Does the thesis preserve the stated counter-case (management guidance, cushions, cures) and the falsifier that would end the call?

dimensions.name: Re-executable evidence strength
dimensions.description: Does the load-bearing claim recompute from the filing's own line items (a covenant ratio, coverage, liquidity runway) rather than resting on a quoted figure or a forward-looking assertion? Re-executable (W1) beats quoted (W2) beats asserted.

dimensions.name: Falsifier presence
dimensions.description: Does the thesis state the explicit observable — the print, filing, or catalyst — that would prove it wrong or close the position?

dimensions.name: Adversarial completeness
dimensions.description: Are management's rebuttal, the sell-side counter, and the structural blunts (equity cure, waiver, cash-netting cushion, add-backs) surfaced and engaged as first-class edges rather than omitted?

dimensions.name: Base-rate and comparable discipline
dimensions.description: Is the call anchored to base rates (how often a technical breach forces a distressed refi vs an amend-and-extend) and comparable situations rather than a single fragile projection?

dimensions.name: Downside asymmetry
dimensions.description: Is the payoff/blast-radius characterized — what the position loses if the contested assumption breaks the other way, and whether the risk is asymmetric — rather than a one-sided case?

rubric_mode_reason: Contested-thesis review is a bounded discriminator over reasoning quality, not a numeric-fit discovery run.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Contested-thesis document review has no numeric fit contract.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Thesis review is not a uniqueness/keyword discovery task.
